item.title: The Coding Harness Is the New Battleground: Why a Veteran User Ditched Claude Code
item.description: The coding-agent battleground moved off the model into the harness: two config formats, single-session wiring, a 15k-token system prompt — a year-long user's migration log and what the shell layer is worth.
